description: Catch hallucinated dependencies before an AI agent installs or calls them, across npm, PyPI, crates.io, Go, Maven, RubyGems, Packagist and NuGet. POST /v1/check with {language, code} and get a diagnostic per import and call (nonexistent package, likely typo-squat, placeholder, suspiciously new, deprecated, nonexistent symbol) as one JSON object. POST /v1/package, /v1/versions and /v1/symbol answer single questions. Pay per request in USDC; no account, no API key.
